name: Gooey Wipe
description: Soft, glossy blobs of liquid pop up over the first clip, swell and melt into each other, revealing the second clip until they cover the frame. Drive `progress` from 0 to 1.

inputs.name: second
inputs.description: Incoming clip (same size as the first)

params.name: blobs
params.description: Number of blobs across the frame

params.name: smoothness
params.description: How smoothly neighbouring blobs melt into each other

params.name: highlight
params.description: Color of the glossy highlight on the rim of the blobs (alpha: strength)

params.name: shadow
params.description: Color of the soft shadow the blobs cast on the first clip (alpha: strength)
